Admission and Application Requirements
Graduate College admission and application requirements are found on the Admission Policies page.
In addition, this program requires applicants to connect with one or more departmental faculty members before and during the application process. Applicants will not be considered without a department faculty member who has agreed to serve as the major advisor.
